FAQ

The questions we're asked most

How much do I pay to book, and when is the balance due?+

Your date is locked with a 50% advance. The remaining 50% is due before the wedding day — that's the full payment schedule, with no hidden charges added later.

How is a booking confirmed?+

Check your date on WhatsApp, choose a package, and your date is locked with a 50% advance. The remaining 50% is due before the wedding day. That's it — after that, all the content worries are ours.

Do you replace our photographer or videographer?+

No — never. A photographer makes the album and a videographer makes the film; that's essential, and we don't replace it. We make phone-first vertical reels and stories built for social media: BTS moments, candid reactions and same-day edits. We work alongside them, without ever stepping into their frame.

How does same-day delivery work?+

Everything is shot on the latest iPhones, and the editing starts right there at the venue. That's why the first reels and stories go live on the day of the function itself — no waiting for months.

Do you travel to other cities — and who arranges travel and stay?+

Yes — Jaipur and Udaipur are our home ground, and we travel all over India for weddings. For outstation bookings, travel, stay and food are arranged by the client, and our team stays at the same property as the wedding — so we're in place before every function begins.

What do you shoot on — camera or phone?+

The latest iPhones. A light setup means no heavy rig comes between you and your moments — people don't pose for a phone the way they do for a camera, so the reactions stay completely raw and real. It's also what makes same-day delivery possible.

What is Wedding Reels India — and is this the official website?+

Yes — this is the official website of Wedding Reels India (WRI): weddingreelsindia.com. We're a Jaipur-based team of wedding content creators making same-day wedding reels, BTS videos and real-time stories — shot on the latest iPhones — for weddings all over India.

Where can I follow Wedding Reels India?+

Everywhere you already scroll: Instagram @weddingreelsindia.co, YouTube @weddingreelsindia, Facebook, X @WeddingreelsIND, Threads, LinkedIn and Pinterest — plus city wedding guides on our blog.
